[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff][u]Hack Forum News - Edition 55[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to the Hack Forum News. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6327870][color=#ffffff]$2k July Contest[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

The Hack Forums July contest is now underway, celebrating the month of July and America's 250th Anniversary with plenty of prizes up for grabs. This months event features cash prizes, Bytes, and permanent upgrades, with every winner also receiving the [b]Lucky Drawing[/b] award [award=186]. Members can earn entries by creating threads, posting around the forum, or referring a new member who upgrades to L33t. With multiple random drawings taking place everyone has a chance to walk away with something. This months contest is sponsored by [mention=3128111] and [mention=5555096] so be sure to check out the contest thread for the full details, and don't forget to join us in thanking them both for helping make this event possible. To be eligible qualifying threads, posts, and referrals must be made during July (GMT -8). All winners will be selected at random during the first week of August. Good luck to everyone taking part and we hope to see plenty of members getting involved throughout the month!

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6327906][color=#ffffff]America Award Sale[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

Keeping with the American spirit the [b]America award[/b] [award=228] is on sale. The award is currently on sale for $25 with no purchase limit, meaning you can build a full row of these on your profile. Any awards purchased during the sale this month will include the description "250 Years of America." If you would like to pick one up or a full row be sure to get yours before the sale ends.

[u][b][size=large]Sony's Disc Era Ends[/size][/b][/u]

Playstation have announced starting in January 2028 new released games will be digital only. Sony plans to reintroduce digital game cards into stores to give customers and retailers a physical option.

[u][b][size=large]PlayStation Movie Library Removals[/size][/b][/u]

Sony have sent out notices stating that 550 Studio Canal digital movies that have been purchased by users will be removed from their library on September 1st, this is due to expired licensing agreements. Opening many users eyes to the risk of digital ownership.

[u][b][size=large]Xbox Game Pass Perks & Sales[/size][/b][/u]

Xbox started July of with some massive sales, reducing more than 30 titles by 90-95% some included titles are Funko Fusion, Zombie Army Trilogy and Worms Armageddon: Anniversary Edition.

[color=#C10300][b][size=15]Peace Is Not the Absence of Problems[/size][/b][/color]
Many people believe peace will come when all their problems disappear. In reality, life will always bring challenges, uncertainty, and setbacks. True peace is not found in a perfect life—it is found in learning how to remain steady even when life is imperfect.
Peace comes from accepting what you cannot control, focusing on what you can, and refusing to let every obstacle steal your happiness. It is built through patience, perspective, and the ability to let go of unnecessary battles.
In a world full of noise, pressure, and constant distraction, finding moments of calm is more valuable than ever.
[hr]

[color=#FF851B][size=15]Advice of the week[/size][/color]
Protect your peace. Not every argument deserves your energy, and not every problem deserves your worry.

[hr]

[color=#008E02][size=15]Quote of the week[/size][/color]  
“Peace begins with a smile.”
— Mother Teresa
